member.name: P:Il2CppSLZ.Marrow.BoxGrip.GrabConfiguration.isCorner
member.summary: Marks an accepted corner, edge or face result from the native box-grab zone check.

remarks.para: Despite its name, the inspected CheckZones sets this flag for successful edge and face grabs as well as corner grabs. It clears the flag at the start of each check. The separate isSandwich flag marks a grab across the box’s thickness.

ValidateGripScore uses this flag to choose its corner scoring branch. A true value therefore does not prove the hand is at a geometric corner, and changing it does not calculate a new grip position. The next zone check replaces the flag.

member.name: P:Il2CppSLZ.Marrow.BoxGrip.GrabConfiguration.isEdge
member.summary: A cached edge-mode flag that native box zone checking clears but does not set for accepted edge grabs.

remarks.para: The complete inspected CheckZones clears this flag at the start. Its accepted edge path sets isCorner instead, so false here does not mean an edge grab was rejected.

ValidateGripScore contains a branch for this flag, but calls CheckZones before reading it. Setting it manually therefore does not select a edge grab through that score path: the zone check clears it again. Use the box’s allowed zones and current hand position to calculate the grab.

member.name: P:Il2CppSLZ.Marrow.BoxGrip.GrabConfiguration.isFace
member.summary: A cached face-mode flag that native box zone checking clears but does not set for accepted face grabs.

remarks.para: The complete inspected CheckZones clears this flag at the start. Its accepted face path sets isCorner instead, so false here does not mean an face grab was rejected.

ValidateGripScore contains a branch for this flag, but calls CheckZones before reading it. Setting it manually therefore does not select a face grab through that score path: the zone check clears it again. Use the box’s allowed zones and current hand position to calculate the grab.

member.name: P:Il2CppSLZ.Marrow.BoxGrip.GrabConfiguration.isSandwich
member.summary: Marks a successful grab across the box’s thickness, using the sandwich hand pose.

remarks.para: This mode is intended for wrapping the hand around a thin part of the box. CheckZones tests the box size and allowed faces, along with canBeSandwichedGrabbed, then calculates the hand target and selects sandwichHandPose when that mode is accepted.

CheckZones clears the flag before each calculation and sets it on a successful sandwich result. ValidateGripScore uses it to select the sandwich scoring path. Setting the flag alone does not create the target pose or perform the grab.

member.name: P:Il2CppSLZ.Marrow.BoxGrip.GrabConfiguration.isZoneValid
member.summary: Caches whether the last box-grip score check found an allowed grab zone for this hand.

remarks.para: ValidateGripScore calls CheckZones and stores its true or false result here. False makes that score return an invalid result; normal hover also refuses the cached target and restores the hand animator’s default pose. True lets normal hover use the calculated local position and rotation to place its target on the box.

This records geometric zone acceptance, not whether the hand is already holding the object. The score check still tests hand-facing direction after a valid zone is found. CheckZones updates the pose and mode fields but does not assign this flag itself; ValidateGripScore performs that assignment. The override hover path uses its force-pull target instead of this validity gate.

member.name: P:Il2CppSLZ.Marrow.BoxGrip.HandToBoxGripState.handPose
member.summary: Stores the hand-pose asset selected for this hand’s current box-grab region.

remarks.para: BoxGrip.CheckZones chooses edgeHandPose, cornerHandPose, faceHandPose or sandwichHandPose according to the accepted region and saves that choice in the per-hand boxHandStates entry. The chosen asset describes how the fingers and handle should be arranged for that style of grab.

Hover and attached-hand updates pass this asset to Grip.SetHandPose. The pose is also used when computing the neutral hand-to-handle offset for the box target, so it affects alignment as well as finger appearance.
This is saved state for one hand, rather than a setting shared by all box grabs. A later CheckZones calculation can replace it.

member.name: P:Il2CppSLZ.Marrow.BoxGrip.HandToBoxGripState.radius
member.summary: Stores the size parameter used to fit this hand’s finger pose to its selected box-grab region.

remarks.para: For edge, corner and face grabs, CheckZones copies the matching BoxGrip edgeHandPoseRadius, cornerHandPoseRadius or faceHandPoseRadius. A sandwich grab, where the hand grips across opposite sides of the box, computes its value from the selected box thickness. The parameter uses world-distance units, normally meters; 0.03 is a 3-centimeter input.

Hover and attached-hand updates pass this value to HandPoseAnimator.SetCylinderRadius. The hand-size multiplier is a unitless scale relative to the reference hand: 1 means reference size. SetHandSize copies that scale and its inverse into the animator; SetCylinderRadius divides by the cached scale before the finger-pose solver chooses a pose. For an illustrative scale of 2, a 0.03-meter input becomes 0.015 meters for the pose solver. Changing the Avatar value later does not itself refresh the animator’s saved scale.

This is a pose-fitting size, not the hand’s grab-search radius or a new collision-sphere radius. Despite the field name, the sandwich path stores the full selected thickness, so every value is not literally a box radius. CheckZones can overwrite the per-hand cache when the chosen region changes.

Sandwich grab scoring also uses this full thickness divided by the avatar’s palm length, plus 1, as one score multiplier. Palm length is the avatar’s cached measurement along the palm, in meters. Orientation and Grip.priority also contribute to the final score. CheckZones rebuilds this per-hand state before normal scoring, so configure the BoxGrip inputs rather than treating this entry as a lasting grab setting.

member.name: P:Il2CppSLZ.Marrow.BoxGrip._45DegSin
member.summary: Stores sin(45 degrees), approximately 0.707, for comparing directions around the box.

remarks.para: Awake, Unity’s initialization routine for this component, calculates this value. CheckZones projects the direction from the box center to the hand into the coordinate planes, normalizes those directions, and compares their axis components with this threshold. That helps distinguish which axis dominates an approach when selecting thin-section and surface alignments.
It is a calculated threshold, not a grab distance, an angle stored in degrees or a user score multiplier. The comparisons use the box’s oriented axes.

member.name: P:Il2CppSLZ.Marrow.BoxGrip._bounds
member.summary: Stores the box center and dimensions used for oriented grab-region calculations.

remarks.para: CheckZones and OnDrawGizmosSelected rebuild this Bounds from _boxCollider.center and size multiplied component by component by this grip Transform’s lossyScale. The size components are made positive. The dimensions are scaled physical distances in meters, while the coordinates still follow the box’s own axes.

The code separately uses the collider Transform’s rotation and position to place these measurements in the world. This is not BoxCollider.bounds, which is a world-axis-aligned surrounding box. Turning the object therefore does not change a face into a different local face.

GetDistanceBetweenFace reads this cache’s half-size along an axis. Editing the cache directly is replaced by the next zone check or gizmo refresh; change the assigned collider’s shape and object scale for the generated measurements.

member.name: P:Il2CppSLZ.Marrow.BoxGrip._boxCenter
member.summary: A stored center vector that the inspected BoxGrip grab calculations do not use.

remarks.para: The complete BoxGrip methods instead calculate and read the active box geometry through _bounds, using the assigned BoxCollider’s center and size and this grip’s scale. Changing this field does not change the zones or targets produced by CheckZones, ordinary hover or UpdateForcePullTransform.
Its name alone does not establish a world or local coordinate convention. Treat _bounds and the collider reference as the geometry actually used by those methods.

member.name: P:Il2CppSLZ.Marrow.BoxGrip._boxCollider
member.summary: The BoxCollider whose dimensions and orientation define this grip’s box-shaped contact regions.

remarks.para: Assign the collider for the box the hands should grab. CheckZones reads its local size and center, and uses its Transform’s rotation and position to place the oriented regions. The calculation multiplies the dimensions by this BoxGrip Transform’s scale, so using a collider on the same object keeps those measurements in the same scaled frame.

The face, edge and corner masks refer to this oriented box. Pose radii and edgePadding affect the contact/animation calculation; they do not resize the BoxCollider itself. The BoxGrip setup methods inspected here do not automatically find and assign this reference.

member.name: P:Il2CppSLZ.Marrow.BoxGrip._grabConfig
member.summary: Runtime contact records that let each hand reuse its selected position and orientation on the box.

remarks.para: Each Hand key has a GrabConfiguration record. CheckZones creates the record if needed, refreshes its contact positions and normal direction, and saves localPosition/localRotation relative to the scaled, centered box frame. A normal is the direction pointing away from the selected surface; scoring compares it with the hand’s facing direction.

ValidateGripScore stores CheckZones’s success in isZoneValid. Ordinary hover requires that flag and turns the saved local target into a world-space target, allowing the contact to follow the box as it moves. This dictionary is generated state, not a collection of hand joint settings.

The native classifier labels accepted edges and faces with isCorner too, and does not populate the individual face/edge/corner enum selectors. Those names cannot reliably report which geometric region was selected; boxHandStates separately carries the pose and radius actually chosen.

member.name: P:Il2CppSLZ.Marrow.BoxGrip.boxHandStates
member.summary: Runtime pose and size settings saved separately for each hand’s selected box grab.

remarks.para: Each entry contains a HandPose and a radius value for the hand animator. CheckZones replaces the entry with the pose/radius for the accepted edge, corner, face or sandwich selection; it removes the old entry before checking. UpdateForcePullTransform also writes an entry using sandwichHandPose and its computed top-axis half-size.

Hover and attached-hand updates apply this entry to the hand animator and grip pose. The dictionary does not store contact positions or an enum identifying the selected region; _grabConfig holds the contact geometry. Changing an authored pose/radius setting affects new selections rather than automatically replacing entries already saved here.

member.name: P:Il2CppSLZ.Marrow.BoxGrip.canBeCornerGrabbed
member.summary: Allows CheckZones to accept a corner grab after it selects the corresponding box region.

remarks.para: This is the overall permission for the corner mode. The selected region must also be included in enabledCorners. A successful selection uses cornerHandPose and saves the mode’s pose radius for later hand updates.

Setting it false rejects a selected corner contact; it does not resize the box or force the same contact to become another mode. Other modes have their own permissions, masks and geometric selection conditions.

member.name: P:Il2CppSLZ.Marrow.BoxGrip.canBeEdgeGrabbed

remarks.para: This is the overall permission for the edge mode. The selected region must also be included in enabledEdges. A successful selection uses edgeHandPose and saves the mode’s pose radius for later hand updates.

Setting it false rejects a selected edge contact; it does not resize the box or force the same contact to become another mode. Other modes have their own permissions, masks and geometric selection conditions.

member.name: P:Il2CppSLZ.Marrow.BoxGrip.canBeFaceGrabbed
